name: Oculus
author: E. T. Carter
description: Looking straight up into a coffered dome that climbs toward a small night-black oculus at centre. A log-polar grid of rounded-rectangle coffers, hue migrating ring by ring, rows born at the frame edge and falling upward into the dark focal depth — a continuous scale-travel that never arrives.

params.label: Rise speed
params.effect: Scale-octaves per second the coffer rows climb toward the oculus.

params.label: Columns
params.effect: Number of angular coffer columns around the dome (rounded to a whole number).

params.label: Bevel glow
params.effect: Strength of the lamplit edge highlight on each coffer's bevel.

params.label: Focal X
params.effect: Horizontal offset of the oculus focal point — slide the dark eye off-centre for an off-axis upward gaze.

params.label: Focal Y
params.effect: Vertical offset of the oculus focal point out of dead-centre.

params.label: Warp
params.effect: Depth-varying angular twist of the coffer grid — 0 a rigid even dome, up a swirling distorted vault that breaks the flat repetition.

params.label: Mouse parallax
params.effect: How far the focal point glides toward the pointer for a smooth look-around (0 locks it; no effect on the static poster).
